events.description: A ceramic bowl opens with soft brush noise and inharmonic resonances.
Smoky filtered ink descends through a slow, continuous pitch fall.
A restrained porcelain crack uses low body resonances and quiet high glints while leaving 1-4 kHz clear for speech.
Gold-nozzle harmonics shimmer with a slow, measured resonance.
A soft swarm of filtered ink tones rises through the D-pentatonic field.
A warm plucked-string resonance evokes a guqin timbre through procedural synthesis, not an authentic recording.
A suspended bell thins and fades toward the exact digital silence.
A single warm, low gold droplet begins immediately after the 30-frame silence and resolves the final passage.
